quests.title: Path of the Taishou

dialogue.t: I explained the situation to the Tenryou Commission and showed them the original documentation. In the end, they believed that the Mystic Onmyou Chamber and I were innocent.
Awesome! Does that mean you can start to focus on your original assignment again?
That's right. I've also restored the Mystic Onmyou Chamber to its original state — a domain dedicated to honing martial prowess.
With time, this Domain may exhaust itself of charm magic. When that time comes, I will let it lie dormant so that power can gradually reaccumulate.
Now might be a good time to give it a try. Are you up for the challenge?

quests.description: This storm has passed. You and Paimon prepare to visit Shiki Taishou again to see how the Mystic Onmyou Chamber is doing…
